name: Phishing Email Triage & Response
description: Automated phishing email investigation workflow. Extracts URLs and attachments, detonates in sandbox, queries VirusTotal, blocks sender, and notifies SOC via Slack. Handles full triage from alert to containment.

name: Malware Analysis Pipeline
description: End-to-end malware analysis workflow. Submits suspicious files to sandbox (Cuckoo/Any.run), enriches IOCs via VirusTotal and MalwareBazaar, extracts C2 indicators, and creates SIEM detection rule automatically.

name: Ransomware Incident Response
description: Critical ransomware response playbook. Immediately isolates infected endpoints via CrowdStrike, disables AD account, snapshots affected systems, notifies incident response team, and opens P1 Jira ticket. Supports rollback orchestration.

name: IOC Enrichment & Threat Intel
description: Bulk IOC enrichment workflow. Accepts IPs, domains, hashes, and URLs. Queries VirusTotal, Shodan, AbuseIPDB, OTX, and MISP. Scores each IOC, deduplicates, and exports enriched report to SIEM and threat intel platform.

name: Alert Triage & Prioritization
description: Intelligent SIEM alert triage. Deduplicate alerts, correlate with asset criticality from CMDB, enrich with threat intel, assign severity score, and route high-priority alerts to on-call analyst via PagerDuty. Closes false positives automatically.

name: Cloud Security Posture: AWS Misconfiguration
description: Automated AWS misconfiguration response. Monitors Security Hub findings for open S3 buckets, exposed credentials, and IAM over-privileges. Auto-remediates low-risk findings, escalates high-risk via Slack, and logs all actions to audit trail.

name: Splunk SIEM Automation — Correlation Rule Tuning
description: Reduces alert fatigue by automatically analysing Splunk correlation rule performance. Identifies high-firing low-fidelity rules, pulls false positive rate, suggests threshold adjustments, and creates Jira ticket for analyst review.

name: Endpoint Response: Suspicious Process Kill
description: Automated endpoint containment for suspicious process activity. On EDR alert, collects process tree, memory dump, and parent-child relationships. Kills process if IOC confirmed, preserves forensic artifacts in S3, and updates case in TheHive.

name: Azure AD Compromised Account Response
description: Responds to compromised Azure AD accounts. Detects anomalous sign-ins, revokes all sessions, resets MFA, disables account temporarily, forces password reset, and notifies user and security team. Integrates with Defender for Identity.

name: Threat Hunt: Lateral Movement Detection
description: Proactive threat hunting playbook for lateral movement. Queries SIEM for pass-the-hash, pass-the-ticket, and Kerberoasting indicators. Correlates with user behaviour baselines, scores anomalies, and generates hunt report with MITRE ATT&CK mapping.

name: DLP: Data Exfiltration Alert Response
description: Responds to DLP alerts indicating potential data exfiltration. Identifies source user, destination IP/domain, volume transferred, and data classification. Blocks outbound connection, quarantines endpoint, and notifies privacy team for GDPR/compliance review.

name: Vulnerability Management: Critical CVE Response
description: Automates response to critical CVE disclosures. Queries Tenable/Qualys for affected assets, cross-references with internet-exposed systems, assigns patching tickets in Jira by asset owner, and tracks SLA compliance. Escalates overdue patches via PagerDuty.

name: GCP Cloud Security: Suspicious API Activity
description: Monitors GCP audit logs for suspicious API calls — unexpected IAM changes, crypto mining patterns, service account abuse. Auto-revokes suspicious service accounts, creates Cloud SCC finding, and pages the cloud security team.

name: Network Intrusion: Beaconing Detection
description: Detects C2 beaconing patterns in network flow data. Analyses Zeek/Suricata logs for periodic outbound connections, scores by regularity and destination reputation, blocks confirmed C2 IPs on firewall, and creates TheHive case with full network context.

name: Sentinel: Automated Incident Creation & Enrichment
description: Sentinel-native automation. On new incident creation, auto-enriches all entities (IPs, users, hosts) with threat intel, correlates with historical incidents, scores incident severity, assigns to correct analyst queue, and posts enriched summary to Teams channel.
